end.gold: Tonight, before Isha: send him one word. “Salam.”

captions: 4:20 p.m. The ferry. A work trip, to his side of the water.
His name is still first in your favourites: Bilal.
Two years ago: one word too many. Then nothing.
Every Eid you thought: he should call first.
A message from Mum: “Your brother asked about you today.”
The ferry docks. You don’t go to the hotel.
Mum’s house. Dinner. He looks up from his plate.
“Salam, Bilal.” Two years, gone in two words.
Pride kept you apart for 730 days. One “salam” brought you back.

post.caption:
730 days of silence. Your brother lives 40 minutes away. 🤍

4:20 p.m., on the ferry to his side of the water. His name is still first in your favourites. Two years ago: one word too many. Every Eid you thought: he should call first. Then a message from Mum: “Your brother asked about you today.”

“Every soul will taste death.” (3:185)

Tonight, before Isha: send him one word. “Salam.”
